name: Butano SP
description: Butano State Park near Pescadero is a redwood park in the Santa Cruz Mountains with hiking through redwood groves and ocean views, still regrowing after the 2020 CZU Lightning Complex Fire.
fullDescription: Butano State Park near Pescadero is a redwood park in the Santa Cruz Mountains with hiking through redwood groves and ocean views, still regrowing after the 2020 CZU Lightning Complex Fire.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hiking trails through redwood groves with ocean views
- Butano Trail Camp open to backpackers (reservations required)
- Main campground (Ben Ries) is closed indefinitely due to fire damage to the water system
- Dogs allowed on leash in the campground, paved areas, and fire roads
- Open 8 am to sunset; phone (650) 879-2040
howToGetIt:
**Fees:**
- Day use: $10 per vehicle ($9 with a senior 62+)

**Save with park passes:** Butano accepts the California Explorer, Golden Poppy, Disabled Discount, Distinguished Veteran, Golden Bear, and Senior Golden Bear passes, plus the California State Library Parks Pass (free to check out at public libraries).
